Concentrated triage batch: `finding` → `pm:queue` + `domain:ui`, Task, S — the location value shape (`{ latitude, longitude }`) is produced and consumed by `LocationField` and declared nowhere importable. Scope: export one value type (`@object-ui/types`, beside `LocationFieldMetadata`) codifying the EXISTING wire shape, and bind `LocationField`'s produce/consume sites to it — declaration catching up to enforced reality, no behaviour change. This is a one-type surface addition; if review judges it contract expansion wanting a ruling, bounce to the decision box rather than arguing in the PR.

## Claimed + dispatched — `domain:ui` @ objectui execution seat

PM session `session_01CSoz9uGhaaSgiq3hshtN7L`, branch `claude/issue-6154-location-value-type`.
The assignee field does not establish whose claim this is — this comment's session ID does. No earlier claim comment exists.

### 裁决 (binding)

**Export one value type** — in `@object-ui/types`, beside `LocationFieldMetadata` — **codifying the EXISTING wire shape** `{ latitude, longitude }`, and **bind `LocationField`'s produce and consume sites to it.**

⭐ **Declaration catching up to enforced reality. NO behaviour change.** ⛔ If the type you write would reject anything `LocationField` currently produces or accepts, it is wrong — widen it to the truth rather than narrowing the runtime. Measure what is actually produced and consumed before writing the type.

### ⛔ Bounce clause — binding, and triage set it deliberately

This is a **one-type surface addition**. ⚠️ **If review judges it contract expansion wanting a ruling, bounce it to the decision box rather than arguing in the PR.** So: if while implementing you find the shape is **not** in fact settled — e.g. an optional third member, a nullable arm, or a second producer disagreeing — ⛔ **stop and report**. A "codify what exists" card stops being that the moment what exists is ambiguous.

### PM机制假设 (verify)

1. `LocationField` genuinely **both produces and consumes** the shape, and the shape is declared by no importable type today. Re-derive on `main`.
2. **Enumerate every producer and consumer** of the value, not just `LocationField`. ⚠️ A card that says "X both produces and consumes it" is exactly the shape that has been incomplete twice tonight — #6110's card named four repair sites where there were **six**, and #6111's named six when the key was dropped at **two hops**. If a second consumer exists (a formatter, a serializer, a map marker path), the type must fit it too, or you have declared a lie.
3. Confirm the wire shape by **measurement** — what actually crosses the boundary — not from the field's local TS annotations, which are the thing being fixed.

### Traps

⚠️ **A type-only change has no runtime pin, so the suite is green before and after.** That green is not evidence. The verification is: the new type **compiles against every measured produce/consume site**, and — the part worth doing — a **reverse check** that the type actually rejects a wrong shape. Paste a deliberately wrong literal at a bound site, show the `tsc` error by name, then restore. Without that leg you have not shown the type constrains anything.

⚠️ **`tsc` resolves workspace deps through `dist` while `vitest` aliases to `src/`** — measured tonight. A type-check red can be unbuilt siblings, a real error, or both (a dev got 15 errors: 14 noise + 1 real). Build the closure first, then classify each remaining error by name. ⚠️ Since this adds a **published** type, run the **downstream** direction too (`--filter '...@object-ui/types'`) and demonstrate the filter direction rather than asserting it.

⚠️ `pnpm --filter <pkg> exec vitest` / `cd packages/x && pnpm exec vitest` hit a guard (objectui#3378) — one form **refuses loudly**, another **silently runs `apps/console`'s 22 files and reports green**. **Always run vitest from the repo root.**

### Standing rules

Predict direction before running; prove mutations on disk by grepping injected AND separately removed text; print the landing site; assert anchor uniqueness; restore under `trap … EXIT INT TERM` with a **cwd-independent** command and confirm `git diff HEAD --stat` empty. Derive gates by enumerating **each CI job's own step list**. Cached turbo green is not a measurement — `--force`.

**Changeset**: a new published type — `minor`, named in words. ⛔ Never `major`.

### Collision bounds

⚠️ **`packages/types` has a live agent right now — #6151** (`StackSchema`'s `Omit` collapsing under `BaseSchema`'s index signature). Your file is the `LocationFieldMetadata` neighbourhood; theirs is the flex/stack declaration. **Different files is fine, same file is not** — check before editing and ⛔ **report any file-level overlap rather than resolving it yourself.**

⚠️ Also note #6151's subject matter directly concerns you: **`BaseSchema`'s index signature can silently erase named members from a type that extends or `Omit`s across it.** If your new value type is declared anywhere in that inheritance path, **verify the emitted `.d.ts` actually carries its members** rather than trusting the source.

Seven other agents are live — ⛔ do not edit `packages/plugin-form/**`, `packages/plugin-list/**`, `packages/plugin-detail/**`, `packages/core/**`, `packages/plugin-kanban/**`, `packages/plugin-map/**`, `packages/app-shell/**`, `examples/schema-catalog/**`, `apps/site/**`; and `packages/components` has the wide #5935 — same-file check applies there too.

⛔ Leave the PR **draft** — the PM lands it.

## Dev report — bounced under the bounce clause, no PR

Session `session_01CSoz9uGhaaSgiq3hshtN7L` execution seat. Branch `claude/issue-6154-location-value-type` pushed at `origin/main` (`ef2a3bd8d`) with **zero commits** — nothing was written, per the clause. Worktree removed.

### Why it bounced

The clause names three triggers: an optional third member, a nullable arm, a second producer/consumer disagreeing. **Two are present by measurement, plus a fourth the card did not anticipate.**

The produce side is settled. Measured from `onChange` by driving the real widget:

```
onChange emissions = [{"latitude":30.2741,"longitude":120.1551}, null]
```

Exactly one object shape, plus a **`null` arm** (`LocationField.tsx:25`, on cleared input). `content/docs/fields/location.mdx` already teaches that arm: `useState<{ latitude: number; longitude: number } | null>(null)`.

The consume side is **not one shape**. `location` has a second consumer inside the *same package*: `LocationCellRenderer` (`packages/fields/src/index.tsx:2290`), registered for `location` at `:2428` — the display half of the same field type. Both rendered against the same values:

| stored value | `LocationField` (edit) | `LocationCellRenderer` (display) |
|---|---|---|
| `{ latitude, longitude }` | `30.2741, 120.1551` | `30.2741, 120.1551` |
| `{ lat, lng }` | **`0, 0`** | `30.2741, 120.1551` |
| `{ lat, lon }` | **`0, 0`** | `30.2741, 120.1551` |
| `"30.2741,120.1551"` | **empty** | `30.2741, 120.1551` |
| `[30.2741, 120.1551]` | **`0, 0`** | `30.2741, 120.1551` |
| `null` | empty | empty |
| `{ latitude }` only | **`30.2741, 0`** | raw JSON |

Four of seven inputs read differently, silently. `packages/plugin-map/src/ObjectMap.tsx:435-459` is a third consumer with the renderer's tolerance, not the widget's.

**The fourth trigger:** `GeolocationValue` — `{ latitude?: number; longitude?: number; accuracy?: number }` — **already exists and is already importable**, from `@object-ui/fields` (`src/widgets/GeolocationField.tsx:12`, re-exported at `src/index.tsx:3183`; verified in the emitted `dist/index.d.ts:743` → `dist/widgets/GeolocationField.d.ts:6`). It is all-optional with an optional third member, and `LocationCellRenderer` is the **single shared display consumer of both `location` and `geolocation`**. So "export one value type in `@object-ui/types`" would mint a second declaration of nearly the same shape, in a different package, for a shape one renderer already serves.

### The bind that cannot be written

The ruling's ⛔ — *"if the type would reject anything `LocationField` currently produces or accepts, it is wrong — widen it to the truth"* — is unexecutable as one type:

- **Widen to the measured truth** and the type is `{latitude?,longitude?,lat?,lng?,lon?} | [number,number] | string | null`. That is not codifying a wire shape, it is **publishing the five-spelling dialect into `@object-ui/types` as the protocol** — the exact accretion AGENTS.md #0.1 forbids, and it makes AI-authored metadata harder to get right, not easier (five legal spellings, no canonical one).
- **Keep it narrow** (`{latitude:number; longitude:number} | null`) and the published type contradicts two shipped consumers and a **live pinned assertion** — `AddressCellRenderer.test.tsx:65,153` asserts a `type: 'location'` value spelled `{ lat, lng }` renders its coordinates. That is the "declared a lie" the dispatch warned about.

A "codify what exists" card stops being that the moment what exists is ambiguous. It is ambiguous.

### Premise check

Both of the card's literal claims verify on `main`:

- **No exported type declares the location value** — TRUE. `grep latitude packages/types/dist/*.d.ts` (built closure, not stale) returns only `designer.d.ts:434` and `objectql.d.ts:1640` `latitudeField` **field-name** keys, plus doc comments. Confirmed.
- **`LocationField` both produces and consumes it** — TRUE, but **incomplete in exactly the way the dispatch predicted**: it is not the only consumer, and the others disagree.

⚠️ One framing correction: the card says *"Observation-class: nothing is broken at runtime."* That is **false**. The `{ lat, lng }` → `0, 0` read is a user-visible wrong render, and `0, 0` is a valid coordinate, not an error state. Filed separately as **#6272** (unassigned, unlabelled for triage).

### The decision

**Which side of the boundary is canonical** — and that answer, not the type, is the deliverable. The type is a one-liner once it is answered; written before it is answered, it fossilizes whichever reading the dev happened to pick.

| | A. narrow type only | B. union of the truth | C. canonical + named input tolerance | D. narrow the runtime |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Real business need** | serves the one measured producer + the docs page that needs to annotate | serves nothing new — no author asked for five spellings; they are accreted reader tolerance | serves both the authoring face and the honest reader face | serves nobody today; breaks two in-repo fixtures |
| **Long-term soundness** | one canonical shape, dialect left undeclared (and so retirable later) | ⛔ publishes the dialect as protocol — #0.1's fossilized second contract | honest, canonical-first, but *names* the tolerance and so blesses it | correct direction, but the ruling forbids it and host data in alias spellings would silently break |
| **AI-written metadata** | ⭐ one shape to write, unambiguous | ✗ worst option — five legal spellings, none canonical | ⭐ canonical is unmistakable, tolerance is explicitly marked legacy | ⭐ but at the cost of a behaviour change the ruling excludes |
| **Startup scope** | ⭐ exactly the one-type addition triage scoped | one type, but a large one | ✗ two types — exceeds the scoped surface | ✗ becomes a migration, not a declaration |

**Recommendation: A**, with two conditions that make it honest rather than a lie of omission — (1) the type is `LocationValue = { latitude: number; longitude: number }` and the binding is `LocationValue | null`, the measured produce shape including its null arm; (2) its doc comment states it is **what the widget stores**, not what every reader accepts, and points at #6272 for the divergence. A is the only option that is simultaneously the scoped one-type addition, canonical-first, and non-fossilizing. B is the option I would refuse to write without a maintainer saying so in as many words.

If the maintainer instead rules that the alias spellings are real, the answer is **B** and #6272 flips to "fix the edit widget"; if they rule they are not, it is **A + D** sequenced, and #6272 flips to "retire the renderer's tolerance and re-fixture". Both are coherent. They are opposite.

### Housekeeping

- **No file-level collision with #6151.** Its subjects are `packages/types/src/layout.ts:226` (`StackSchema`) and `packages/types/src/base.ts:69` (`BaseSchema`); this card's target file is `packages/types/src/field-types.ts:400`. Different files, and `BaseFieldMetadata` (`field-types.ts:23`) is a standalone interface that does **not** extend `BaseSchema` — so a value type declared there sits outside #6151's index-signature erasure path entirely. Noted for whoever picks this up after the ruling.
- Build closure green (`pnpm --filter '@object-ui/fields^...' --filter '@object-ui/fields' build`, exit 0) — required before any `dist/*.d.ts` claim above.
- Measurement probe ran from the **repo root** (`pnpm exec vitest run <path>`), `Test Files 1 passed (1)`, and was deleted. `git status` clean, `git diff HEAD --stat` empty.
- No changeset, no PR, no labels touched, no assignee touched.

## ⛔ 状态纠正 + 升级至决策箱 —— 本卡此前的标签在撒谎

`domain:ui` @ objectui 执行席,PM session `session_01Mn4BZ5AVDM81pvfij1WwM9`(身份 `os-litant`),接管自 `session_01CSoz9uGhaaSgiq3hshtN7L`(账号 `yinlianghui` 已退休)。

### 纠正了什么

本卡此前挂 `pm:dispatched` + assignee,读起来是「有 agent 在做」。**实际上 dev 早已结束** —— 06:36Z 按 bounce 条款交回,零代码。分支 `claude/issue-6154-location-value-type` 实测 `git rev-list --count origin/main..` = **0**,head `ef2a3bd8d` 就是当时的 `origin/main`,即基线本身。

⚠️ 这个形态**比缺一步更危险**:接手方看到「`pm:dispatched` + 分支存在」,按停滞 claim 判据得出「活的 claim,别碰」,于是**没人做、也没人知道该做什么**,卡会一直躺着。半成品看得出来缺;撒谎的状态看不出来。

本笔一次改齐:`pm:dispatched` → `needs-user-decision`,取消 assign。⛔ 不是重派 —— dev 的交付是**正确的**,它按条款停在了该停的地方。

### ⚠️ 顺带纠正一条我自己传错的读数

我在接管记录里写过「`6fd2cf7a` 不是 main 提交 ⇒ 有真实工作」。**错了**,那是基线。实测本轮七张在飞卡只有 **#6071(2 个提交)和 #6151(1 个)** 有提交,其余全是 0。

教训值得留在卡上,因为它今晚以同一形态出现了三次:**一个分支的 sha 跟兄弟不一样,什么都不能证明 —— 两个都可能是基线。要数提交,`git rev-list --count origin/main..<branch>`,不要从「观察到差异」跳到「差异有含义」。**

## 为什么这是决策而不是实现

dev 的 bounce 条款点了三个触发器,**实测命中两个,外加卡片没预料到的第四个**:

- **produce 侧是定的**:驱动真实控件测得 `onChange` 只发一种形状 `{latitude, longitude}`,外加一个 **`null` 臂**(清空输入时)。
- **consume 侧不是一种形状**:同包内 `LocationCellRenderer` 是第二个消费者,`ObjectMap.tsx:435-459` 是第三个。**七个输入里四个两边读法不同且无声**:`{lat,lng}` / `{lat,lon}` / `[lat,lng]` 在编辑控件里读成 **`0, 0`**,字符串形读成空,而显示侧全部读对。
- **第四个触发器**:`GeolocationValue`(`{latitude?, longitude?, accuracy?}`)**已经存在且已经可导入**,来自 `@object-ui/fields`,并且 `LocationCellRenderer` 是 `location` 与 `geolocation` **共用的显示消费者**。

所以裁决里那句 ⛔「若类型会拒绝 `LocationField` 当前产出或接受的任何东西,就是写错了,要放宽到真相」**作为单一类型不可执行**:放宽到实测真相 = 把五种拼写当协议发布进 `@object-ui/types`(AGENTS.md #0.1 禁止的化石化第二契约);保持收窄 = published 类型与两个已发货消费者和一条**活的断言**(`AddressCellRenderer.test.tsx:65,153` 钉着 `{lat,lng}` 渲染出坐标)矛盾。

**「codify what exists」这张卡,在 what exists 变得有歧义的那一刻就不再是这张卡了。**

⚠️ 同时更正卡片原文一句:「Observation-class: nothing is broken at runtime」**为假**。`{lat,lng}` 在编辑控件读成 `0, 0` 是用户可见的错误渲染,而 `0, 0` 是合法坐标不是错误态 —— 它以「看似合理的错处」失败,不是显性失败。已另立 **#6272**(无 assignee、无标签,待分诊)。

## 四棱分析

**要裁的是:location 边界哪一侧是 canonical** —— 控件写入的那一种形状,还是显示侧容忍的五种拼写?类型本身在答案定了之后是一行的事;**先写类型就是把 dev 恰好选中的那一侧化石化**。

| 评估轴 | A. 只发 canonical 窄类型 | B. 发实测真相的联合类型 | C. canonical + 具名输入容忍 | D. 收窄运行时 |

## ⛔ Escalating to the decision box — the 2026-08-25 ruling's premise is void, and the ruling is inverted

`pm:dispatched` → `needs-user-decision`, claim released, PR #6418 left as a **draft carrying a
DO-NOT-MERGE banner with `Fixes #6154` removed**, so an accidental merge cannot silently close
this card. `domain:ui` @ objectui execution seat, PM session `session_011SfZeFWrhGLHmfq61xbz4q`.

The dev took **fork B** as instructed, wrote no further code, and reported. I have verified what
is verifiable from inside this repo.

### The measurement

`@objectstack/spec@17.2.0` — the version installed against this branch, and `@object-ui/types`
already declares `^17.0.0`, so it could import it:

```ts
// @objectstack/spec/data — CANONICAL
LocationValue = { lat: number; lng: number; altitude?: number; accuracy?: number }

// also upstream, @deprecated
LocationCoordinates = { latitude, longitude, altitude?, accuracy? }
//   "Never consumed by the runtime, and its key names contradict what the platform
//    actually stores … Removal rides the next spec major."
```

Runtime, not just declarations — `valueSchemaFor({ type: 'location' })` and `LocationValueSchema`
agree exactly:

| value | verdict |
|---|---|
| `{ latitude, longitude }` — what `LocationField` produces | ❌ **REJECTED**, `invalid_type at [lat]`, `[lng]` |
| `{ lat, lng }` — the two in-repo fixtures | ✅ accepted |
| `{ lat, lng, altitude, accuracy }` | ✅ accepted |

### ⭐ Corroborated from inside this repo, independently of the spec

`packages/fields/src/__tests__/AddressCellRenderer.test.tsx:65` and `:153` render
`type: 'location'` as **`{ lat: 30.2741, lng: 120.1551 }`**. The bounce report cited those two
lines as *"a live pinned assertion"* for a **dialect** the ruling declared not-contract. They are
in fact pinning the **spec-canonical** spelling. The repo's own fixtures were telling us which way
round this was, and every reader — the card, the bounce report, the ruling, my dispatch — read
them as evidence for the opposite conclusion.

### The ruling is inverted at three points

1. **The name was never objectui's to mint.** `@objectstack/spec/data` has always exported it.
2. **The "alias spelling" IS the contract.** `{ lat, lng }` is canonical; `{ latitude, longitude }`
   is the deprecated one, already scheduled for removal at the next spec major. Option A was
   chosen precisely to avoid "publishing the dialect as protocol" — it would have published the
   *deprecated* shape as protocol instead.
3. ⚠️ **#6272's ruled fix direction is backwards.** "Retire the display-side tolerance in
   `LocationCellRenderer`/`ObjectMap` and re-fixture the two `{lat,lng}` test files" would retire
   the spec-canonical spelling and re-fixture **spec-conformant** fixtures.
   `LocationCellRenderer` reading `lat`/`lng` first is correct-by-contract, not tolerance. The
   real divergence is that **`LocationField` produces a shape the enforced contract rejects.**

And the card's two halves can no longer both be done: bind `LocationField` to the spec's
`LocationValue` and `onChange({ latitude, longitude })` stops compiling. *"Publish the type AND
bind the widget, with no behaviour change"* is now unexecutable as one change — exactly what the
original bounce clause predicted, for a reason nobody had measured.

### ⭐ Why four consecutive records carried the same false negative

The card, the bounce report, the maintainer ruling and my dispatch all rested on "no exported type
declares this." **Every census behind them searched objectui's tree.** `@objectstack/spec` is an
upstream published dependency and was never in anyone's pathspec — including mine, and including
the bounce report's otherwise-careful freshly-built-`dist` reading.

The positive control that was run (252 non-test `latitude|longitude` hits) proved the **search
worked**. It could not prove the search **looked in the right place**. That distinction is the
transferable lesson and I have put it into the seat's standing dispatch criteria: *for any
"nothing declares X" premise, the pathspec must include `node_modules/@objectstack/*` or it is not
a census.*

**背景**:2026-08-25 的裁决(「同意你的建议」)选了 Option A,前提是「没有任何导出类型声明过 location 值形状,由 objectui 铸这个规范类型」。该前提**经测量为假**:上游 spec 早就拥有这个名字,且把 objectui 正在产出的那个拼写标为 **@deprecated**。裁决据以成立的事实基础没了,所以这不是「按原裁决继续执行」的问题。
